paragraphs:
Lucifer: Are you okay?

Chloe : If I pushed this into your chest... it would kill you?

Lucifer: Yes

Chloe : Because I'm close to you?

Lucifer: Yes

Chloe : But you jumped in front of it anyway

Lucifer: Yes...

Lucifer: And I would do it again... and again...

Lucifer: Don't you know that, Detective?
